# User password

The password of a user. `osapi dsl behavior get --name password` and
`osapi dsl behavior method get` show the same.
[Its chain](../../../../chains/security/password.md) shows each call that its
examples make.

## Method update

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | update                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Description | Set the password of a user                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Detail      | Sets the password with chpasswd -e, from its hash on standard input. The controller hashes the password, so the job and NATS have only the hash. Each call makes a new hash, so it always reports changed: true. A user that the host does not have is not found. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped. |
| HTTP        | PUT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/user/&#123;name&#125;/password                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Permission  | user:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Command     | [osapi client node user password update](../../../../../usage/cli/client/node/user/password/update.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Input type  | UpdateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

### Input (3)

| FIELD         | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                      | DESCRIPTION                                                                                                                      |
| ------------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name          | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-z_]\[a-z0-9_-]\*\$?$, max length 32 | The user, such as alice                                                                                                          |
| password      | string | no       | pattern ^\[^\r\n]\*$, format password            | The new password, which osapi hashes on the controller. A secret: a reference, secret://&lt;vault&gt;/&lt;key&gt;, or the value. |
| password_hash | string | no       |                                                  | The sha512-crypt hash of the password, which the controller sets                                                                 |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| name    | string  | The user                 |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |
